title: Albums with artist names
statementMd:
For albums 1 to 5 show title and artist name.

Expected columns: `title`, `artist`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT al.title, ar.name AS artist FROM albums al JOIN artists ar ON ar.id = al.artist_id WHERE al.id <= 5;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
